queries:
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS overall_avg FROM eq
),
above AS (
  SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum
  FROM eq, overall
  WHERE eq.avg_hum > overall.overall_avg
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS group_mean FROM above
)
SELECT above.equipref, above.avg_hum - grp.group_mean AS diff_from_group_mean
FROM above, grp
ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) AS a
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
),
above AS (
  SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum
  FROM eq, overall
  WHERE eq.avg_hum > overall.a
),
gm AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) AS m
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
    AND equipref IN (SELECT equipref FROM above)
)
SELECT above.equipref, above.avg_hum - gm.m AS diff_from_group_mean
FROM above, gm
ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
)
SELECT AVG(humepct)
FROM scanenvironment
WHERE equipref IN (
  SELECT equipref
  FROM eq
  WHERE avg_hum > (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) FROM eq)
);
SELECT AVG(avg_temp) AS group_mean
FROM (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(ambictemp) AS avg_temp
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
) t
WHERE avg_temp > (SELECT AVG(ambictemp) FROM scanenvironment WHERE ambictemp IS NOT NULL);
WITH eq_avg AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry, AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_hum
  FROM equipment e
  LEFT JOIN scanenvironment se ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry
  GROUP BY e.equipregistry
)
SELECT equipregistry
FROM eq_avg
WHERE avg_hum IS NOT NULL
  AND avg_hum > (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) FROM eq_avg WHERE avg_hum IS NOT NULL);
SELECT AVG(s.ambictemp) AS avg_ambient_temp
FROM equipment e
LEFT JOIN scanenvironment s ON e.equipregistry = s.equipref
HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(s.ambictemp);
